title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook with metrics integration
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds a per-prompt regression CI hook to the eval-harness that runs lightweight per-prompt checks on PRs touching prompts or model interface code, emits per-prompt metrics to our CI metrics pipeline, and gates merges based on configurable thresholds. Motivation: Teams have been observing regressions that only surface on a small subset of prompts; current per-suite checks are too coarse. This change introduces a CI hook that runs the eval harness in a fast, per-prompt mode, reports prompt-level deltas (win/loss/regression) and summary metrics to the CI metric sink, and fails the job if any prompt falls below defined quality thresholds. The description includes changes to: 1) a new GH Actions workflow and CI hook entrypoint, 2) a new eval-harness CLI flag (--per-prompt-ci) that skips long-running samples and runs a reduced eval set with cached model outputs when available, 3) metrics integration to CI telemetry via ci-metrics-client and a new metric namespace eval.per_prompt.delta, 4) docs and developer guide for adding prompt-level exemptions and thresholds, and 5) tests for the new path. Related Linear: ENG-2045 (per-prompt regression gating), ENG-2088 (ci metrics plumbing). This PR aims to reduce noisy rollbacks by surfacing small regressions earlier and providing visibility into prompt-level regressions for on-call and owners. The description is intentionally a single continuous string without section breaks.

review_conversation: Ravi Kapoor (reviewer): Please explain how this interacts with the existing per-suite gating. Can we reuse cached artifacts to keep runtime < 10m?

Aisha Patel (author): The per-prompt CI mode is orthogonal to per-suite gating; it runs only when prompts or eval code change. It uses the new CI artifact cache; when matched we short-circuit large model runs and use stored outputs to compute deltas, keeping runtime typically under 6 minutes in our perf runs.
Emily Chen (reviewer): Code looks good but we should make thresholds configurable per-prompt and allow team-level exemptions. Add a docs page and a Linear link.
Aisha Patel (author): Added exemptions config and documented in docs/eval/per-prompt-ci.md. Also added a small helper to mark prompts as allowed-regressions with owner signoff.

Aisha Patel (author): Added retry with exponential backoff and deterministic fixture for tests. Re-ran CI and all checks passed.

release_notes: Added per-prompt CI regression hook and metrics integration. Teams can opt prompts into stricter gating by adding entries to eval/per_prompt_thresholds.yaml. This improves detection of small regressions at prompt granularity and publishes metrics to eval.per_prompt.delta for long-term trend analysis.

@@ -120,6 +120,14 @@ def add_eval_args(parser):
     parser.add_argument('--skip-slow', action='store_true', help='skip slow eval samples')

     if args.per_prompt_ci:
